CORE ABILITIES          Deadly Demise D3, Firing Deck 11
ARMY RULES               Waaagh!

Raucous Occupants: While this model is within range of your home

objective, add the OC of models embarked within this model to this
model's OC

Fortification: While an enemy unit is engaged with onlyes
FORTIFICATION units:

* That enemy unit can be selected as a target of ranged attacks.

= When shooting that enemy. unit, those ranged attacks have -1 to
hit rolls (excluding [CLOSE-QUARTERST] attacks).

= When that enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if
that enemy unit is only engaged with FORTIFICATION units, and
that enemy unit is not battle-shocked, hazard rolls made for
that enemy unit are automatically passed.

Ramshackle Cover: When an attack targets a unit that is not fully
visible to the attacking model because of this unit, the target has
the benefit of cover against that attack.

TRANSPORT

This model has a transport capacity of 11 ORKS INFANTRY
models. It cannot transport GHAZGHKULL THRAKA models. Each
MEGA ARMOUR/ JUMP PACK model tak        the space of 2 models.

UNIT COMPOSITION

= 1Big'ed Bossbunka model

FACTION KEYWORDS:
